title: feat(pm): an enqueue by an authorized account is the human review at the queue
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ86NgoAHToTmDrgbochfTZyA)_
Fixes #26066
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changed

The governed queue guard's `merge_group` leg now passes a governed pull request when EITHER an account in `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` holds a latest-decisive APPROVED review (the 2026-09-04 predicate, unchanged and read first) OR that account put the entry in the queue. The maintainer's own "Merge when ready" from `os-zhuang` or `hotlong` is the human review; no separate Approve is owed. The approver set is unchanged and is still the single constant.

- `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`
  - `enqueuerFromTimeline` / `authorizedEnqueueVerdict` / `undeterminedEnqueue` (pure) and `makeTimelineReader` (paged `GET /issues/N/timeline`, throws on truncation because the newest event is on the last page).
  - `runGuard` reads the enqueuer SECOND, only for an entry the approval did not satisfy (monotone, free for approved entries), before any Tier S record read. `entrySatisfied` gains the enqueue limb between the approval and the record; `satisfiedBy` names the leg.
  - Log line (card §3): `✅ enqueued by an authorized account: LOGIN (added_to_merge_queue at T)`, a third CLEARED wording ("The ENQUEUE leg satisfied N of them: #N (enqueued by LOGIN)") so the clear never claims an approval it did not read, and on refusal `⛔ enqueued by LOGIN, outside GOVERNED_APPROVERS` or `⛔ enqueuer UNDETERMINED — reason`.
  - Size limb (card §4): `runSizeGuard` hands the enqueue reading beside the approval verdict to the sibling's lift; a governed and oversized PR costs one timeline read, not two. Remedies on both legs name the enqueue landing; the bypass-rules option stays named.
  - Header: a dated section for the 2026-10-26 ruling (verbatim quotes), the measured reading, why this is not the actor-field attribution #11704 retracted, the accepted cost, and the exit-table rows for 0 / 3 / 8.
- `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` (claim amendment, those two functions and their pins only): `sizeLiftFrom` reads an `authorized` enqueue as a second lift after the approval lift; `renderLiftApprovals` renders it; new `SIZE_ENQUEUE_LIFT_RULING`.
- `AGENTS.md`, inside its line ratchet (1,117 lines before and after, no line over 120 bytes): Prime Directive 14 says Tier H lands "by the maintainer's hand (merge or enqueue) or an authorized approval"; one sentence adds "An authorized account's enqueue is a review record too: ⛔ never a seat's."; and Multi-agent §7 (c) says the size line lands by "the maintainer's merge or enqueue". The details (for that queue entry only, undetermined never passes) are in the guard header, which is where the rule's detail lives.

## The enqueuer reading, measured (card §2)

Measured on 2026-10-26 against the live REST API of this repository:

- Newest `added_to_merge_queue` timeline event's `actor.login` answers both paths. #26154 and #26011: armed through auto-merge, and the add event's actor is the account that armed it. #26166: direct enqueue, add event present, and no `auto_merge_enabled` event at all.
- `auto_merge.enabled_by.login` is null on a direct enqueue (#26166 never had one) and on every merged PR read, so it answers only the armed path. Not used.
- `GET /issues/N/timeline` answers `X-Accepted-GitHub-Permissions: issues=read; pull_requests=read`. The workflow's existing `pull-requests: read` covers it, so `.github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml` is untouched.
- Not measured: a `merge_group` run's own token reading the timeline, and an enqueue armed from an authorized account reaching the queue (#26138 was armed by `os-zhuang` and not yet queued at read time). The first live queue build after this lands prints the reading either way, and an unreadable one is UNDETERMINED, which is today's behaviour.

UNDETERMINED is never a pass: no add event, an actorless add, an unreadable or truncated timeline, and a newest queue event that is a removal (the current entry is not on the timeline yet, so the earlier add belongs to an entry that left) all leave the approval leg to decide alone, on its own exit code (3, not 4).

## Tests

At head `9e0ae37b` (the last commit touched only `AGENTS.md`; both self-tests re-run there):

- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`: 373 cases pass (was 345). New battery "the 2026-10-26 ENQUEUE leg" with 28 cases, floor 27 to 28. It covers the card's four fixtures (authorized enqueue with no review passes and names the leg; seat enqueue with no review is refused on 3 with today's words; seat enqueue with an authorized approval passes on the review leg and never reads the timeline; unreadable enqueuer with no review is refused on 3 naming UNDETERMINED). It also covers a stale add before a removal, no reader, an unreadable review list beside an authorized or a seat enqueue (0 and 4), the PR leg reading nothing, a Tier S entry clearing without a record read, the size lift and its refusal, `main()`'s wiring at one timeline read, and the reader's paging, truncation and non-2xx paths.
- `node scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs --self-test`: 537 assertions pass, including 3 new enqueue-lift pins.
- Ablation 1, enqueue limb of `entrySatisfied` mutated (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, blob `ecad10abe0f0` to `e05e95b1cbb5`): 5 of 373 cases red (fixture 1, its words, the unreadable-review case, the Tier S case, the governed-and-oversized case). Restored, blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Ablation 2, the removal-newest guard in `enqueuerFromTimeline` mutated: the stale-add case red (1 of 373). Restored, blob equals HEAD. The first attempt hit an anchor miss (wrong indentation), wrote nothing, and was re-run on the right anchor.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths; 3 changed paths vs merge base `fbb75998b`): 42 families.

- At head `9e0ae37b`: 41 of 42 run locally, all exit 0 (exit captured before any pipe), including `node scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --self-test`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-prose`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `pnpm check:required-contexts`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`. `--ran` reconciliation: 42 derived, 41 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 1 UNRUN.
- The UNRUN one is `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`. It ran at `8258383f` (the head before the AGENTS.md-only rewrap commit) and exited 0: fast tier, 1917 cases, 618 s. It was not re-run on `9e0ae37b`; CI runs it.
- The first run at `8258383f` had one red, `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`: AGENTS.md was over its 1,117-line ceiling (1,121) and had two lines over 120 bytes. The sentences were rewritten to fit the existing lines (no ceiling raised, no unrelated re-wrap). It is green at `9e0ae37b`.
- ESLint (`pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config`) on the two changed scripts: exit 0. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- The dispatch order names `pnpm check:governed-queue-guard-self-test`. No such script exists in `package.json`; the guard's `--self-test` is in the derived list and was run directly. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's per `.claude/agents/os-dev.md`; ESLint ran locally on the two changed scripts (exit 0).
- An enqueue counts for that queue entry only: a seat's re-enqueue after an ejection is a new entry by a seat account and is refused without the approval or another authorized click. That is the card's "newest" reading; carrying the click across ejections the way ruling C carries an approval would be a separate maintainer decision.
- Tier H (`AGENTS.md`). This PR stays draft and lands by the maintainer's hand. Chicken-and-egg: until this change is in `main`, that hand is an APPROVED review or the bypass-rules merge, not the enqueue.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:合并队列守卫多认一种"人工审核":PR 若是由授权账号(os-zhuang 或 hotlong)点"Merge when ready"送进队列的,队列守卫直接放行,不再要求先点 Approve。体积超 3000 行的 PR 同样适用。其他账号(包括车队机器人)入队仍然必须有授权 Approve。

**为什么改**:您在手机上原来要先点核准再点合并;按您的要求("大部分我还是希望入队，但是我想省掉 Approve"),以后直接点合并(入队)即可。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:守卫读的是 PR 时间线上最新一次"入队"事件的操作账号。① 授权账号若被智能体代操作,入队就等于放行,所以 AGENTS.md 同步写明:任何智能体席位都不得以任何账号在未获批的受管 PR 上入队或开自动合并。② 入队后到落地前再推的提交不会被重新审核,与"批准在任意提交上都算"的代价相同。③ 读不到入队者时不放行,仍按原规则判。回滚:还原本 PR 即可,无数据迁移。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:本 PR 改了 AGENTS.md,属 Tier H,需要您亲手落地:点 Approve 后由席位落地,或直接合并。新规则要等本 PR 进 main 后才生效,所以这一次还不能只靠入队。
